005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
010
011/**
012 * A stage in a command builder where requirements have already been specified and execution details
013 * are required. The next stage is a {@link NeedsNameBuilderStage} from {@link
014 * #executing(Consumer)}. Additional requirements may still be added before moving on to the next
015 * stage.
016 */
017@NoDiscard
018public interface NeedsExecutionBuilderStage {
019  /**
020   * Adds a required mechanism for the command.
021   *
022   * @param requirement A required mechanism. Cannot be null.
023   * @return This builder object, for chaining
024   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirement} is null
025   */
026  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement);
027
028  /**
029   * Adds one or more required mechanisms for the command.
030   *
031   * @param requirement A required mechanism. Cannot be null.
032   * @param extra Any extra required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot contain null values.
033   * @return This builder object, for chaining
034   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirement} is null or {@code extra} contains a null
035   *     value
036   */
037  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement, Mechanism... extra);
038
039  /**
040   * Adds required mechanisms for the command.
041   *
042   * @param requirements Any required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot contain null values.
043   * @return This builder object, for chaining
044   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code requirements} is null or contains a null value.
045   */
046  NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Collection<Mechanism> requirements);
047
048  /**
049   * Sets the function body of the executing command.
050   *
051   * @param impl The command's body. Cannot be null.
052   * @return A builder for the next stage of command construction.
053   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code impl} is null.
054   */
055  NeedsNameBuilderStage executing(Consumer<Coroutine> impl);
056}
